      "observations": [
        "The complete one-path patch makes useOpenPGPKey tolerate null and undefined with keyId?.toUpperCase() || \"\". It now stores the same normalized gKeyId in openpgp_key_id, then updates is_gnupg_key_id and reloads the UI. This is a key-state transition, not only an exception guard.",
        "The fixed accepted function retains the landed normalization and attribute write. Initial account loading, radio commands and successful internal/external key callbacks all route through this function. The radio refresh treats an empty key as None; later controls depend on gKeyId truthiness while S/MIME certificates can keep encryption or signing enabled.",
        "The changed JSDoc adopts {?string}; it keeps the old key-wizard description and does not explicitly describe undefined or clearing a key. The review proposed a more explicit null explanation, optional chaining and direct normalized storage. Actual source adopts the latter two, not the exact proposed description; Not Done does not override this source check.",
        "No tests change. The inspected current key-wizard assertions cover imported-key listing, selection and identity storage, not direct null/undefined removal. Their expected-state messages are non-empty; missing should alone is not a defect in this historical review.",
        "The short guarded expression and separate identity/GnuPG/UI steps are readable local groups. This scoped use of optional chaining and || does not create a global null/default or equality rule.",
        "Required primary Bug 2026319 was originally read by Parent and reconciled here from the exact retained full record. It reports clearing an external key can supply null/undefined and stop the old function at toUpperCase; Bug 1838189 remains an unread regression locator.",
        "The full own D289925 contains three actual submitted inlines and two replacement tables. The owned diff adopts the optional-chain/empty-string expression and stores gKeyId; it adopts nullable {?string} but not the exact suggested clearing-key wording. All three Not Done labels and the later reviewer promise to change/land are retained separately from actual code adoption. Landing with ongoing/failed builds is historical, not a new test result."
